mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the front and retina was most worthwhile because the leaf's light path and outgoing nerve connected the separate parts into one understandable system.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the iris was fairly predictable once its picture showed the opening, though it clarified where the ring sits.

surprise.text: The retina's nerve fibres gather into one outgoing bundle, the optic nerve; that made the connection to the brain clearer.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained what the parts were for.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the brain uses the eye's signals, although these combinations were straightforward rather than challenging.
